packageRules.description: Keep ts-api-utils on 1.x. TypeScript 7 ships no JavaScript compiler API, so a hoisted ts-api-utils@2.x resolves the root typescript@7 stub and crashes `vite build` (precinct -> detective-typescript -> @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree reads ts.TypeFlags). The 1.x devDependency forces estree to nest its own ts-api-utils, which resolves precinct's bundled TypeScript 5.x. See PR #187 / #190.
